reason: Read complete Webb Theorem 12.5.2 pp244-245. Multiplying b=sum Tr_Q^D(u_Q) by Tr_D^G(a)=b yields b=sum Tr_Q^G(a u_Q), with a in the block and D-fixed. Thus all trace ideals are inside the block centre; locality supplies a proper trace expression contradicting vertex minimality. The trace-support lemma bounds every surviving subgroup by a conjugate of D, and conjugation equivariance plus maximality gives the converse. See research/phase-2-catchup-24-step3b-e.md.
